newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.
newsitem.headline: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.

text.p: The following is a daily forecast of yield spreads of Portuguese fixed rate bonds (OTs) against Bonos and Bunds.
Spread Feb 2007 OTs vs Jul 2007 Bund 60/62.4/66 vs 61 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 2007 Bono -13/-15/-17 vs -15 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 1999 OTs 106/107.2/108 vs 107 bp
Jun 97 future BPDOTM7 (0814 GMT) -0.01 points to 108.97
Main factors that could influence trade:
Today's FOMC meeting which will review short term rates.
Decision on rates will be known after local markets close.
